title: Runkeeper Activity Weekly Average Pace Trend
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=runkeeper:activity pace_min_km=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(pace_min_km) as avg_duration, max(pace_min_km) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst average pace for Runkeeper activity events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture pace_min_km on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average average pace with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It safely whether Runkeeper activity tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
